name: build-v1
notes: 2026-11-14. Measured: hornLength 25 (shaft to ball), rodLength 190 (ball to ball), rods lean ~20 deg from vertical at home. From the CAD in base_reference/: servo pairs straddle the base seams with parallel shafts along the seam (servoYawDeg = baseHalfAngleDeg), shaft lines 49.1 mm either side of the seam; top joints in pairs 10.8 mm apart at the corners of the top triangle, each pair above a base pair (the model then predicts a 21 deg rod tilt). Servo seat in the CAD puts the shaft face 78.8 mm out along the seam; the bottom ball centre is estimated 9.2 mm beyond it (servoInset). Estimated, to be measured: bottom ball centre to plate centre (sets baseRadius, ~101 mm) and the top ball centre offset from its mounting face (sets platformRadius, ~80 mm). Servos lie on their sides, so the collision box is 19.7 tall and 40.7 along the horn, shaft ~10 mm from the outer end. 2026-11-15: servoMinDeg -75 and hornRodMinDeg 8 verified on the rig (figure8 SIZE 23 hold at phase 283: servo 5 at -73.6 deg, rod 8 deg from the horn, clear); the other limits are still placeholders. 2026-11-18: frontDeg 60 puts the front (+x) between servos 1 and 6 (was toward servos 1/2). Labels are the numbers written on the servos; legs run counter-clockwise from above, the labels clockwise. 2026-11-21: horns now have a bolt spacer between the horn and the lower ball, which moves the ball centre outward along the shaft. Not yet in the geometry: measure servo shaft face to lower ball centre along the shaft (new servoInset, was 9.2 est.); that also moves the pivot, so baseRadius = hypot(78.8 + servoInset, 49.1) and baseHalfAngleDeg = servoYawDeg = atan2(49.1, 78.8 + servoInset). With the spacer, servo 1 swept the whole firmware window (-99.8 to +99.8 deg, other servos level) with nothing touching (Servo limits panel clear sweeps, measurements/limit-marks-2026-11-21.json). Fit: servoMinDeg -75 -> -99.8, servoMaxDeg 70 -> 99.8, hornRodMinDeg 8 -> 3.4 (the smallest horn-rod angle the model can follow on that sweep; below -84.3 deg it has no pose). Verified on servo 1 only: sweep servos 2-6 before relying on horn angles past -75/+70.
